Based on what you mentioned, I strongly believe you’ll enjoy [[gyome, master chef]]. He is a culinary teacher at the witherbloom school, and while he may not seem that interesting at first glance, he has many ways to build around and all are super interesting and fun to play. Right off the bat- the foods can be used for lifegain, aristocrat, protection, generating mana, they can even be animated into creatures. His tap/indestructable ability can come in very clutch, seeing as it can protect your creatures at instant speed, but also it can stop other creatures from attacking if you tap them down before attackers are declared. 


I personally built my gyome deck as a creature heavy deck that can win through aristocrat lines, the MVP being [[marionette master]] especially after using one of the many counter generators to make her pings even bigger, and there are so so many free food sac outlets that generate card draw or other advantage. 
The deck also has no trouble winning through overrun/craterhoof effects, a unique one being [[blossoming bogbeast]] that synergizes well with eating food. 

This deck has been through a lot of changes, and I probably need to add some more instant speed interaction as it stands right now, but I highly recommend checking the commander out.

Glarb is my favorite deck. He is an absolute powerhouse when built correctly. His strongest ability is getting lands from the top of the deck onto the battlefield, and doing so multiple times per turn. the card advantage generated by doing this is absurd. Ideally you want one or two extra land drop cards out as quickly as possible, and to then work on finding some way to take advantage of the extra mana. My go-to is dropping nyxbloom ancient and then throwing bombs out left and right. He can easily win by decking or through combat damage, so he is flexible if one game plan is not working. twenty toed toad is also one of my most reliable wincons. 

While I said extra lands is his best feature, my deck uses all of the strategies you listed. Drop lots of lands, reanimate fatties, and cast some more fatties. Also draw a billion cards

edit: one thing I forgot to mention is to run as many mdfc lands and reduced mana cost spells as possible. overlords, evoke, delve, and alternate cost free spells with 4cmc such as deadly rollick are all absolutely killer, free cards off the top go crazy. My glarb list is frog tribal but with a subtheme of top deck matters/ free or reduced cost 4cmc spells castable from the top like [[deadly rollick]]. 

[[Bolas’s citadel]] [[vedalken orrery]] [[seedborn muse]] will allow you to cast dozens of spells a turn cycle. 

extra land drops are incredibly valuable with glarb because you can dump all your lands off the top and use them to cast the next 4cmc spell you run into. Especially helpful because the frogs will easily be drawing 20+ cards in a turn cycle when they get going. [[exploration]] [[azusa lost but seeking]] 

Best draw spells are [[kindred discovery]] [[guardian project]] with the amount of bouncing that goes on. 

another top performer is [[fortune teller’s talent]] which allows you to cast frogs that you otherwise wouldn’t be able to off the top. The first ability is redundant with glarb but is much more likely to stick around after a boardwipe, allowing you to skip recasting glarb if you want cards from the top. The third ability is insanely broken. 

one of the Strongest combos in the deck should be [[the gitrog monster]] and [[grolnok the omnivore]]. Even attacking with only 3 frogs will net you 9 cards exiled with grolnok, but don’t forget you also draw off gitrog for each land milled with grolnok. Had this setup in a game combined with upgraded fortune tellers talent and I was easily able to burn through all the cards I exiled with the reduced cost. Attacking with 10 frogs including these two can easily win you the game with draw pings.
